info.title: Autobench
info.description:
A containerised, parallel evaluation platform for LLM agents.

A trial is a pure function of (task version, agent version, model version, seed)
and it leaves nothing behind. Every endpoint here exists to defend that sentence.

get.description:
Liveness. Deliberately dependency-free — it answers "is the process up".

A liveness probe that checks the database restarts the API when Postgres
blips, which turns a recoverable outage into a cascading one.
Readiness. This one *does* check dependencies — that is the difference.

Prometheus exposition (PRD §13.2).

Counters that belong to the worker process are exported by the worker; what
the API can answer authoritatively is the *state of the warehouse*: queue
depth, trial outcomes, spend, and worker liveness.

Serve a locally-stored artifact.

Only used when ``artifact_backend=local``; the S3 backend hands out
presigned URLs that never touch the API.

post.description:
Upload a task directory and run the static gates.

Static only: the calibration gates need an executor, and this endpoint has
to answer while an author is still typing. They come back ``skipped``, which
is not the same as ``passed`` — ``publishable`` stays false until something
has actually run the oracle.

Register a task version from a server-side directory.

Content-addressed: registering unchanged content returns the existing
version rather than creating a duplicate, so a CI job that re-registers the
whole corpus on every push is idempotent.

post.description: Cooperative cancel. In-flight trials notice within a few seconds.

Re-queue ``infra_*`` failures only.

Agent failures are the agent's result. Re-rolling them until they pass is
exactly how a benchmark inflates its own numbers, so this endpoint cannot
do it even if asked.

Paired bootstrap over the shared task set, plus McNemar on the flips.

``inconclusive`` is the field the UI must respect: when the delta interval
straddles zero, the comparison renders grey. The frontend is not allowed to
imply a difference the statistics do not support.
